metadata.name: POC recovery query (hysteresis 70-80)
metadata.description: Exercises recovery_strategy:"query". Breach when avg_cpu > 80; recovery when avg_cpu < 70. The 70-80 dead band means breach and recovery are not exact complements, producing distinct recovering spans. An active group is recovered when it appears in the recovery query result (see build_alert_events.buildQueryRecoveryAlertEvents).

breach.query: FROM kbn-data-forge-fake_hosts.fake_hosts-* | WHERE event.dataset == "system.cpu" | STATS avg_cpu = AVG(system.cpu.user.pct) BY host.name | WHERE avg_cpu > 80

recovery.query: FROM kbn-data-forge-fake_hosts.fake_hosts-* | WHERE event.dataset == "system.cpu" | STATS avg_cpu = AVG(system.cpu.user.pct) BY host.name | WHERE avg_cpu < 70
